summary: Confirmed family data and deletion authorization gaps fixed locally and tested in dedicated emulators. Production is unchanged. Remaining profile-stat integrity, payload validation, bearer-media lifecycle and large deletion workflows prevent a full security sign-off.

findings.issue: Original reply Storage reads allowed every authenticated user; original challenge/reply deletion allowed every family member.
findings.recommendation: Local fixes restrict family reads and creator/parent deletion. Deploy only after merged rules/device verification.

findings.issue: Family administrators could modify global betaApproved.
findings.recommendation: Local rule now requires global admin for changes; emulator confirms denial for family admins.

findings.issue: Removing a family member failed because user familyCircleId changes were forbidden.
findings.recommendation: Local narrow atomic-removal rule checks existing admin and post-write membership; emulator verifies access revocation.
Local author/parent checks, field allowlist and text limits are tested.

findings.issue: Legacy user XP/activity/streak fields are client-writable; some updates are not transactional.
findings.recommendation: Migrate legacy stat mutations to validated server operations while preserving sign-in behavior.

findings.issue: Image writes previously lacked type/size limits; other profile/family fields still have incomplete schema bounds.
findings.recommendation: Image type and 10 MB limits added locally; finish profile/family validation with existing-account fixtures.
